//: Pinned external inputs of the regression suite. Baselines are only comparable when these match: a different yosys places different logic, so an unpinned synthesiser silently invalidates every recorded number.

oss-cad-suite.why: the exact synthesiser apio installs for users, so our measurements describe what they will get; must equal the pin in lib/common.sh (scripts/check-pins.sh asserts it)

demo-projects.status: wired: tests demo-arty and demo-basys3; scripts/fetch-demos.sh materialises the tree under regress/external/ (gitignored; SKIP when absent)

excluded.vexriscv, vexriscv_smp: generators (sbt/SpinalHDL, litex), not runnable designs — vendor their output instead
excluded.blinky-qmtech and the kintex7/zynq/spart: their parts are not in chipdb-parts.json yet
excluded.litex-*: heavy python environment; tier 3, never a gate

apio.status: superseded (§4.1 scope boundary): scripts/asset-check.sh verifies the published assets by apio's URL rule without installing apio; tests that DRIVE apio live in the apio repo
